products.title: Parker 10126 Male NPTF Pipe Crimp Fitting, Rigid, Straight (26 Series)
products.descriptionShort: Parker 10126 26 Series crimp hose fitting — Male NPTF Pipe, rigid, straight, for textile-braid and low-pressure hose. 8 sizes, hose -4 to -16, steel, zinc dichromate plated.
products.descriptionLong:
The Parker 10126 is a 26 Series permanent (crimp) hose fitting: Male NPTF Pipe, rigid, straight. Parker lists the 26 Series for Parker 201–261, 206, 213, 221FR, 225, 235, 244, 266, 285, 293 and SS23CG hoses. It is a No-Skive fitting — it crimps over the hose cover, so the cover is not stripped before assembly.

Specification

  • Series: Parker 26 (textile-braid and low-pressure hose)
  • End connection: Male NPTF Pipe
  • Form: Rigid, Straight
  • Material: Steel, zinc dichromate plated
  • Hose bore: -4 to -16 (1/4" to 1")
  • End sizes: -2 to -16
  • Assembly: Parker Parkrimp crimpers

Sizes and part numbers

8 Parker part numbers — the Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists each with its end thread and hose bore. Parker numbers read style and series, then end size, then hose size: 10126-2-4 is a -2 end on -4 (1/4") hose.

Assembly

Crimp the fitting only onto a hose Parker approves for the series, using the crimper and die setting Parker publishes for that fitting and hose. Do not mix fittings and hose from different series or makers in one assembly; the assembly is only rated as a matched combination.

How to order

Quote the Parker part number, or send the end connection, end size and hose. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
